```{r}

#Bringing the files together

library("dplyr")

#Merge the datasets with 1688 observation.
aibl_data<-cdr%>%

  inner_join(labdata)%>%
  inner_join(mmse)%>%
  inner_join(neurobat)%>%
  inner_join(pdxconv,by=c("RID"="RID","SITEID"="SITEID","VISCODE"="VISCODE"))


#Merge the datasets with 862 observations only. These remain fixed for the all the trials  over the testing period. 

#Remove SITEID and VISCODE, as these are not relevant, because these variables remain fixed for all the participants.
medhist1<-medhist[,c(-2,-3)]
apoeres1<-apoeres[,c(-2,-3)]
ptdemog1<-ptdemog[,c(-2,-3)]

#Merge with the key RID only.
 aibl_data<-aibl_data%>%
  left_join(medhist1)%>%
  left_join(apoeres1)%>%
  left_join(ptdemog1,by=c("RID"="RID"))

head (aibl_data)

arrange(aibl_data, RID)

head (aibl_data)

sapply(aibl_data, class) # UNDERSTAND CLASS
dim(aibl_data) # checking the dimensions of the dataframe
names(aibl_data) #list of variable names

aibl_data <- aibl_data[aibl_data$VISCODE=='bl', ]
# aibl_data_m18 <- aibl_data[aibl_data$VISCODE=='m18', ]



```

```{r}

# Before Pre processing

aibl_data_raw <- aibl_data
aibl_data_raw$DXCURREN <- ifelse(aibl_data_raw$DXCURREN == 1 , "HC", "Non-HC")
aibl_data_raw$DXCURREN <- factor(aibl_data_raw$DXCURREN)

# Split the data into training and testing sets
set.seed(12345)

train_index <- createDataPartition(aibl_data_raw$DXCURREN, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- aibl_data_raw[train_index, ]
test_data <- aibl_data_raw[-train_index, ]


# Modelling with Random forest (RF) model
rf_model <- randomForest(DXCURREN ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500)
rf_predict <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
rf_cm <- confusionMatrix(rf_predict, test_data$DXCURREN)
print(rf_cm)


```

```{r}
# Pre processing

aibl_data <- aibl_data[, -which(names(aibl_data) %in% c("RID","VISCODE","EXAMDATE","APTESTDT","PTDOB"))]

cols_to_factor <- c("PTGENDER","MHPSYCH","MH2NEURL","MH4CARD","MH6HEPAT","MH8MUSCL","MH9ENDO","MH10GAST","MH12RENA","MH16SMOK","MH17MALI","CDGLOBAL","DXCURREN")

# Factor the selected columns using mutate_at()
aibl_data <- aibl_data %>% mutate_at(vars(all_of(cols_to_factor)), factor)

unique(aibl_data$DXCURREN)
# Missing value imputation

aibl_data[aibl_data == -4] <- NA

aibl_data$DXCURREN[aibl_data$DXCURREN == 7] <- NA

aibl_data$DXCURREN <- ifelse(aibl_data$DXCURREN == 1 , "HC", "Non-HC")
aibl_data$DXCURREN <- factor(aibl_data$DXCURREN)
# Remove duplicate rows using distinct()
aibl_data <- distinct(aibl_data)

col_index <- which(names(aibl_data) == "DXCURREN")  # Get the current index of the column
aibl_data <- aibl_data[, c(1:(col_index-1), (col_index+1):ncol(aibl_data), col_index)]

write_csv(aibl_data, "C:/Users/bless/Desktop/Project/DV&V/AIBL__data-.csv")

```
```{r}

aibl_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/bless/Desktop/Project/DV&V/AIBL__data-.csv")

# Feature Engineering
# Binning

aibl_data$MMSCORE <- ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE <= 10, "sever", 
          ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE <= 20 & aibl_data$MMSCORE > 10,"modest",
          ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE <= 24 & aibl_data$MMSCORE > 20,"early", 
          ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE <= 30 & aibl_data$MMSCORE > 24,"normal", NA))))
# table(aibl_data$MMSCORE)

cols_to_factor <- c("PTGENDER","MHPSYCH","MH2NEURL","MH4CARD","MH6HEPAT","MH8MUSCL","MH9ENDO","MH10GAST","MH12RENA","MH16SMOK","MH17MALI","CDGLOBAL","MMSCORE","DXCURREN")

# Factor the selected columns using mutate_at()
aibl_data <- aibl_data %>% mutate_at(vars(all_of(cols_to_factor)), factor)




# Perform Data Visualization to find outliers
aibl_data_long <- aibl_data %>% 
  gather(key = "variable", value = "value", -DXCURREN)

# Create a box plot of all variables by Diagnosis using facet_wrap
ggplot(aibl_data_long, aes(x = DXCURREN, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Diagnosis", y = "value") +
  ggtitle("Box Plot of AIBL Dataset by Variable")



```

```{r}

table(aibl_data$DXCURREN)
write_csv(aibl_data, "C:/Users/bless/Desktop/Project/DV&V/AIBL_for_Smote_data-.csv")

# Data balancing with SMOTE

# install.packages("vctrs")
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("dongyuanwu/RSBID")
library("RSBID")
AIBL_Smote_data <- SMOTE_NC(aibl_data,31)
summary(AIBL_Smote_data)

table(AIBL_Smote_data$DXCURREN)


AIBL_Smote_data <- AIBL_Smote_data[,-1]

AIBL_Smote_data$MMSCORE <- as.factor(AIBL_Smote_data$MMSCORE)
AIBL_Smote_data$MMSCORE <- as.numeric(AIBL_Smote_data$MMSCORE)
AIBL_Smote_data$DXCURREN <- factor(AIBL_Smote_data$DXCURREN)

#Shapiro-Wilk test
shapiro_results <- lapply(AIBL_Smote_data[,-ncol(AIBL_Smote_data)], shapiro.test)

p_values <- sapply(shapiro_results, function(x) x$p.value)
p_values
non_normal_vars <- names(p_values[p_values < 0.05])
non_normal_vars
```

```{r}
# Load the required packages
library(stats)

# Standardize the data
scaled_data <- scale(AIBL_Smote_data[,-ncol(AIBL_Smote_data)])

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(scaled_data)

# Calculate the explained variance
explained_variance <- pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2)

# Select the number of principal components
num_components <- 2  # Example: Retaining 2 principal components

# Calculate the loadings
loadings <- pca_result$rotation[, 1:num_components]

# Select the top features based on loadings
top_features <- colnames(AIBL_Smote_data)[which.max(abs(loadings))[]]

# Print the top features
print(top_features)

```

```{r}
correlations <- cor(AIBL_Smote_data[,-ncol(AIBL_Smote_data)], method = "kendall")
# install.packages("corrplot")
library("corrplot")

corrplot(correlations, number.cex = .9, method = "circle", type = "full", tl.cex=0.8,tl.col = "black")

# Apply Boruta algorithm to select features
# install.packages("Boruta")

library(Boruta)

boruta_obj <- Boruta(DXCURREN ~ ., data = AIBL_Smote_data, doTrace = 2, ntree=500)

aibl_data_selected <- AIBL_Smote_data[, boruta_obj$finalDecision == "Confirmed"]


correlations1 <- cor(aibl_data_selected[,-ncol(aibl_data_selected)], method = "kendall")

corrplot(correlations1, number.cex = .9, method = "circle", type = "full", tl.cex=0.8,tl.col = "black")

```
```{r}

# After Pre processing

aibl_data_final <- aibl_data_selected

# Split the data into training and testing sets
set.seed(12345)

final_train_index <- createDataPartition(aibl_data_final$DXCURREN, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
final_train_data <- aibl_data_final[final_train_index, ]
final_test_data <- aibl_data_final[-final_train_index, ]


# Modelling with Random forest (RF) model
rf_model <- randomForest(DXCURREN ~ ., data = final_train_data, ntree = 500)
rf_predict <- predict(rf_model, final_test_data)
rf_cm <- confusionMatrix(rf_predict, final_test_data$DXCURREN)
print(rf_cm)
```
